description: Open-licensed instrument and sound recordings for Gravitunes. Only CC0, CC BY, CC BY-SA and University of Iowa MIS files. fetch.py downloads them to data/earth/instruments/<id>/.

missing.kora: no clearly licensed single-instrument recording found on Wikimedia Commons; try Freesound (needs FREESOUND_API_KEY)
missing.banjo: only MIDI on Commons; try Freesound
missing.balalaika: only spoken-word files on Commons; try Freesound
missing.pan_flute: no clean recording found; try Freesound
